PS12-Evil-Wheel-of-Fortune/starter/READM.content:
# Evil Wheel of Fortune

Keep `dictionary.txt` beside `main.py`. Run the starter to count three-letter
candidates. Have the program choose a word length from three through eight. For each guess,
group the remaining words by where the letter appears, including the family
with no occurrence. Display a pattern from a largest family and keep only
that family's words. A guess that reveals no letter costs one turn. Type
`quit` to leave an unfinished game.

PS12-Evil-Wheel-of-Fortune/starter/main..content:
with open("dictionary.txt", encoding="utf-8") as source:
    words = set(source.read().split())

sample = {word for word in words if len(word) == 3}
print(f"Three-letter candidates: {len(sample)}")

PS13-Typewriter-Monkeys/solution/main.py.content:
import random
import string

with open("valid_words.txt", encoding="utf-8") as source:
    valid_words = set(source.read().split())

print(f"Loaded {len(valid_words)} three-letter words.")


window = ""
for count in range(1, 10_001):
    window = (window + random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase))[-3:]
    if window in valid_words:
        print(f"Found {window} after {count} generated letters.")
        break
else:
    print("No word found in 10000 generated letters.")

# Start the game with all of the players free (i.e. no one has been captured yet)
team1free = set()
team1free.add("Jared")
team1free.add("Rachel")
team1free.add("Khalif")
team1free.add("Claudia")
team2free = set()
team2free.add("Zeinab")
team2free.add("Michael")
team2free.add("Matthew")
team2free.add("Valerie")

team1captured = set()
team2captured = set()


# Keep playing until either someone steals the flag or an entire team gets captured
while True:
    try:
        captured_flag = input("Did someone capture the flag? (Y/N): ").strip()
    except EOFError:
        break
    if captured_flag.lower() == "y":
        print("Game over, someone captured the flag!")
        break
    else:
        try:
            captured = input("Did someone get captured? (Y/N): ").strip()
            name = input("Who got captured? ").strip() if captured.lower() == "y" else ""
        except EOFError:
            break
        if captured.lower() == "y":
            # Check which team the player was on
            if name in team1free:
                # Move captured player from free to captured set
                team1free.remove(name)
                team1captured.add(name)
            elif name in team2free:
                # Move captured player from free to captured set
                team2free.remove(name)
                team2captured.add(name)
            else:
                print("I don't see that player out on the field!")

        # Print everyone who is free on each team
        print("Here are the players who are still on the field for team 1:")
        for name in sorted(team1free):
            print(name)
        print("Here are the players who are still on the field for team 2:")
        for name in sorted(team2free):
            print(name)

        # Print everyone who is in jail
        print("Here are the players who are in jail:")
        total_captured = team1captured.union(team2captured)
        for name in sorted(total_captured):
            print(name)

        # Check if an entire team has been captured
        if len(team1free) == 0:
            print("All of team 1 is in jail, so team 2 wins!")
            break
        elif len(team2free) == 0:
            print("All of team 2 is in jail, so team 1 wins!")
            break

# Debugging Sets

Run `python3 main.py` and locate the first exception. Repair setup, moving
players between sets, reporting the two rosters, combining the captured
sets, and detecting an empty team. After setup passes, answer n, y, Jared.
Jared should appear in the captured roster and disappear from team 1's
field roster. Try that capture again and then enter y to end the game.

        # Move captured player from free to captured set
        team2free[name] = 0
        team2captured.append(name)
      else:
        print("I don't see that player out on the field!")

    # Print everyone who is free on each team
    print("Here are the players who are still on the field for team 1:")
    for i in range(len(team1free)):
      print(team1free[i])
    print("Here are the players who are still on the field for team 2:")
    for i in range(len(team2free)):
      print(team2free[i])

    # Print everyone who is in jail
    print("Here are the players who are in jail:")
    totalCaptured = team1captured.team2captured.union()
    for name in totalCaptured:
      print(name)

    # Check if an entire team has been captured
    if team1free == 0:
      print("All of team 1 is in jail, so team 2 wins!")
      break
    elif team2free == 0:
      print("All of team 2 is in jail, so team 1 wins!")
      break
